name: Open-Meteo forecast API: current conditions
dataset: current temperature_2m, relative_humidity_2m, precipitation, weather_code for a latitude/longitude
frequency: Model output updated about every 15 minutes; fetched hourly
licence: Free API for non-commercial use under CC BY 4.0 (attribution required; limits 10,000 calls/day). Commercial deployments need an Open-Meteo subscription.
usageNotes: Model-based weather data. It is NOT India Meteorological Department (IMD) data and must not be described as official IMD observations.
